speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your symptoms of fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, I need to determine if this is an infectious or malignant process. Have you noticed any B symptoms such as drenching sweats or a decrease in appetite over the last few weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That loss of weight is significant. Have you noticed any itching, or have you had a fever that comes and goes? Also, please tell me if you have a history of alcohol use or liver disease.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST IMAGES: Supraclavicular_Lymph_Node_Ultrasound. Given the fixed nature of the node and your significant weight loss, we must also check your liver function; please tell me if you have experienced any jaundice or dark urine recently.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma with Hepatosplenomegaly. I recommend immediate biopsy of the lymph node and a CT scan of the abdomen to confirm staging.
